Description: Electrician started unbolting crude booster pump motor without locking the 415V main power switch. Live electrical power was still connected to the equipment.
Two contract tank cleaners entered inside crude storage tank T-04 without continuous oxygen level meter testing and without any standby safety watchman outside.
Derrickman was observed standing 25 meters high on the derrick pipe-racking platform with his safety harness lifeline unhooked from the anchor point.
Well testing crew opened the wellhead valve on a sour gas well with toxic hydrogen sulfide (H2S) gas without wearing personal gas alarms or breathing apparatus.
Welder started using an open flame cutting torch only 3 meters away from an open drain leaking flammable hydrocarbon gas with no fire extinguisher present.
Mobile 20-ton crane was hoisting a 5-ton metal drilling motor using a torn, worn-out synthetic lifting belt with broken fibers over workers on the ground.
A heavy 15 kg iron casing tong wrench slipped from an overhead rig platform and dropped 12 meters down, landing 1 meter from a floor worker.
Control room operator tied a wire around the emergency shut-off valve ESDV-101 to bypass automatic emergency safety shutdown during pressure spikes.
Crude oil tanker truck driver was tracked speeding at 78 km/h on a narrow, muddy rain-soaked field road without wearing a seatbelt.
High-pressure hydrotest pipeline pumped to 3500 psi did not have safety whipcheck cables or safety chains connected on the flexible pressure hose.
Mechanic opened a 2-inch drain valve on an operating oil separator before releasing trapped pressure, spraying hot crude oil condensate across the pump bay.
Workers built a 6-meter high scaffolding platform for pipe painting without installing mid-guardrails or toe-boards along the outer open edge.
Contractor crew spotted working near a high-pressure line during routine operations, possible boundary concern needing review.
Unusual equipment vibration noticed near rotating pump shaft during shift handover, requiring engineering check.
Spilled floor cleaning detergent and rainwater left in the main admin building hallway, creating a slippery floor hazard for office staff.
Store helper was carrying cardboard boxes of printer paper and office stationery into the warehouse without wearing protective work gloves.
One fluorescent tube light on the ceiling of the storage tool room was flickering, causing slightly dim lighting over the workbench.
Plastic dust covers were missing from the emergency eye wash fountain in the battery charging room. The water flow operated normally when tested.
An employee accidentally discarded clean shredded office paper into the red hazardous oily waste drum instead of the regular waste bin.
Empty plastic water bottles and snack wrappers were left on the floor near the tool storage box in the crew rest room.
Sun-faded paint on the outdoor emergency muster point assembly sign board near the security perimeter gate.
Contract security guard walked across the asphalt parking lot during afternoon lunch break without wearing his clear safety glasses.
